name: AI Data Protection
description: Protects personal data around AI tools: redacts emails, phone numbers, national, payment, passport, birth-date and health identifiers from prompts, tool inputs and tool outputs before they are stored, and checks pasted or tool-captured images for the same data. IP addresses, names and addresses are left out by default; add them to the rule if your organisation treats them as personal data in developer work.

rules.name: Redact personal data in prompts, tool inputs and tool outputs
rules.description: Scans user prompts, tool call inputs and tool outputs for personal data and redacts it before the event is stored. The tool call itself proceeds unchanged.

rules.name: Gate images that contain personal data
rules.description: OCRs pasted images and images passed to or returned by tools, and matches the same personal-data categories. A hook cannot change image pixels, so the organisation's enforcement level decides the outcome: justify asks the person to paste a redacted image or give a reason, enforcing stops the prompt with a crop-and-resubmit message, monitor only records it. Fails open if the image scanner is unavailable.
